_note_evidence_authority: The authoritative primary-domain gate. The Agent-12 R2 evidence manifest classifies every admissible source by the SHA-256 of its bytes, and is read out of the git object store at a pinned commit -- never from the sibling worktree, whose contents depend on when somebody looked. Set commit to the exact 40-character SHA once the branch publishes the manifest; until then the ref does not resolve, plan reports the absence, and every run fails closed with no source classified. Renaming a file cannot change what this gate says about it.
_note_evidence_manifest: The run-local frozen manifest, which supplies search spaces and circularity classes. Where it and the R2 authority disagree about a parameter's eligibility, the R2 authority wins by supersession rank and the disagreement is recorded. It does not exist in this repository yet, so plan and run both refuse.
_note_wave1: Interface for the SHA-bound Wave-1 calibration result from the orchestrator lane, covering blowout_treatment and sample_size_regularization. Leave path empty until Wave 1 publishes: absence is a state, not an error, and the two parameters keep whatever disposition the evidence manifest gives them. When set, all ten bindings are verified against what this run independently holds.
_note_headline_quantities: The predeclared headline subset for the Monte Carlo convergence diagnostic -- the only judgement configuration supplies, and it is a judgement about which outputs matter rather than about how much divergence is acceptable. Everything else is derived from the run samples: binomial sampling error for path-fraction probabilities, run-reported empirical error for means, a Sidak family-wise threshold over this subset, a proportion-of-outliers rule over the whole diagnosed family, and a catastrophic single-output threshold. There is no absolute percentage-point tolerance anywhere, and no second human stop between the tiers.
_note_required_advisories: Advisories do not halt a run. Naming one here is the single exception, it applies only before the approval gate, and it is a policy decision made before the run rather than a reaction to the advisory when it arrives. After the approval an advisory can never stop a tier.
_note_base_seed: Null until the governed run seed is set. When present it is bound into the publish and freeze gates.
_note_executor: package.module:factory naming the model-run executor. Empty means the unmounted default, which refuses every call -- correct while the governed calibration and execution interfaces are not mounted. Named in configuration rather than on the command line so the run manifest records which interfaces the run was driven through.
